D: Superman tries to do good in a world that doesn't trust him, while Lex Luthor plots to bring him down.
P: Serve the snacks when Krypto comes bounding in.
S: Pork mince with onion and sage rolled in puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C for 25 minutes, cut into bites with tomato sauce.
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese and topped with smoked salmon, capers and red onion.
Crisp cucumber, radish and fennel shaved thin, dressed with lemon and salt, served on crushed ice.
M: Ma and Pa Kent's farm dinner
Clark going home to his parents in Smallville
Beef chuck pot roast braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes, gravy from the pot.
Chicken thighs grilled with lemon and garlic, sliced into flatbread wraps with tomato, lettuce and garlic sauce.
W: Buttery shortcake scones baked at 220C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar for half an hour.
K: Cold milk shaken with honey and vanilla, poured into tall glasses.

s.how: Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with cream cheese and top with a fold of smoked salmon, a few capers, thinly sliced red onion and a sprig of dill. Lay them out on a tray like the morning spread at a newsroom.

Shave 2 Lebanese cucumbers, a bunch of radishes and a fennel bulb paper thin with a peeler or mandoline. Toss with lemon juice and sea salt flakes. Pile onto a plate of crushed ice so it looks like a crystal fortress and serve straight away.

m.n: Ma and Pa Kent's farm dinner
m.note: Clark going home to his parents in Smallville
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 500ml beef stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Thicken the juices into gravy and serve family style.

w.how: Slice 500g strawberries and toss with 2 tbsp sugar, then leave 30 minutes. Rub 80g butter into 450g self-raising flour, add 300ml cream and mix to a soft dough. Cut rounds and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Split and fill with whipped cream and strawberries.

d.how: Pour 1L cold milk into a big jar with 2 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla. Put the lid on and shake hard until frothy. Pour into tall glasses and serve straight away, the way it would be at a Kansas farmhouse table.
